concepts.def: Kotler (1967): segmentation, targeting, positioning; the strategic core of modern marketing.
Levitt (1965): introduction, growth, maturity, decline; informs Boston Matrix and extension strategies.
BCG (1968): stars, cash cows, question marks, dogs based on market share and growth; guides portfolio investment.
1957: market penetration, market development, product development, diversification - four growth options.
Aaker (1991): value added by a brand beyond functional benefits; built via awareness, perceived quality, loyalty, associations.
SEO, paid search, social media, content marketing, email; UK digital ad spend hit £29.6bn in 2023 (IAB).
